The Pleasure of a Book That Refuses to Hurry

A short note on reading at the pace a book asks for.

By Steve Berkowitz August 2, 2026 About 4 minutes
Attention Time

Some books punish impatience. That can be part of the appeal.

The best reading experiences are not always the most efficient ones. Sometimes the point is to accept the pace of the thing in front of you.

—

Thank you for reading.
